scope: First six two-storey pilots; planning rule, never a replacement gate

area_rule.area_definition: Union area of upper-storey tile footprints before cutting measured stair openings; physical area, not standable area

basis.primary_source_title: UK Approved Document B, Volume 2, buildings other than dwellings
basis.sections_examined: Printed page 14, Table 2.1; paragraphs 2.3 and 2.6-2.7; PDF page index 25. Text examined; other pages were not comprehensively read.
basis.source_facts_paraphrased: The table distinguishes normal industrial premises, with 25 m for a single direction and 45 m when alternatives are available, from higher fire hazard cases with shorter limits. Occupancy and layout also matter. Direct distance is not interchangeable with measured route distance.
basis.inference: The 2000 m2 service area is our disclosed layout heuristic, chosen near a 45 m square area scale. The document does not prescribe one stair per 2000 m2, and a square area scale does not establish a 45 m walk-distance bound.
basis.cannot_support: No UK fire-code compliance, occupancy determination, emergency egress certification, or actual maximum travel distance is established. No gate threshold is changed.

position_rule.x: Distribute target arrivals at width * i/(M+1), then select the nearest centre of a 10 m column bay; ties deterministic
position_rule.orientation: Rotate the native traversal exit to world -Y so the final landing is supplied by the mezzanine slab
position_rule.y: Measure native transformed shaft bounds. At that X interval find the continuous mezzanine strip depth in 21 m cell increments. Set arrival Y = max(4 m, strip_depth/2 - actual_forward_shaft_extent/2).
position_rule.openings: Cut the actual shaft envelope with 0.35 m side clearance, terminating at the native measured final-riser interface; the top traversal endpoint remains 5 mm on the slab side
position_rule.clearance_work: Clear only root-overlay machinery whose actual bounding box intersects the measured stair/approach/egress envelope; preserve every removed instance and source hash in AUTHORING.json
position_rule.validation: Original clipping, approach, egress, support, G25, G8 and Standability thresholds remain authoritative. Actual graph walk-distance statistics will be reported descriptively if the graph is available.

cannot_support: This declaration assigns stair count and placement before candidate authoring. It does not prove those positions are physically usable, connected, compliant, or accepted.
